default.notes: Not on the ASAN e-Visa list — apply for a visa at an Azerbaijani embassy before travel; check current e-Visa eligibility on evisa.gov.az, as the list is updated periodically.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days under CIS-era and bilateral agreements — register with the State Migration Service if staying more than 15 days.
Gulf Cooperation Council nationals can obtain a 30-day visa on arrival at Azerbaijan's international airports.
Eligible for the ASAN e-Visa — apply online (about 3 working days, USD 25) for a single-entry 30-day stay; confirm eligibility on evisa.gov.az.

AZ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Azerbaijani citizens.

AM.notes: Azerbaijan refuses entry to citizens of Armenia. Travellers of Armenian descent or with evidence of visits to Nagorno-Karabakh also face refusal or removal.

XK.notes: Azerbaijan does not recognise Kosovo — Kosovo-issued passports are generally not accepted for entry; contact an Azerbaijani mission about alternatives.

CN.notes: ASAN e-Visa required at present; a China–Azerbaijan visa-waiver arrangement has been announced — confirm the current position on evisa.gov.az before travel.
